name: French Toast with Cinnamon and Berries
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip the bread slices until soaked through.
Brown in butter, 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve topped with berries.

name: Egg in a Hole
steps: Cut a round hole in each slice of bread.
Butter the pan and toast the bread on one side.
Flip, crack an egg into each hole and cook until set.
Season with pepper.

name: Bagel with Cream Cheese and Lox
steps: Split and toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese.
Top with salmon, tomato, red onion, capers and dill.

name: Bacon, Egg and Cheese Bagel Sandwich
steps: Crisp the bacon.
Fry the eggs.
Toast the bagel.
Layer bacon, egg, cheddar and spinach and close.

name: Shrimp and Grits
steps: Cook the grits in water until creamy and stir in the cheddar.
Crisp the chopped bacon and keep a spoonful of fat.
Sauté the pepper and garlic in the fat, add the seasoned shrimp and cook 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon and green onion over the grits.

name: Cheese Grits with a Fried Egg
steps: Cook the grits in water until thick.
Stir in cheddar and pepper.
Fry the eggs in butter.
Top the grits with an egg and chives.

name: Breakfast Hash with Potatoes and Peppers
steps: Dice the cooked potatoes small.
Brown the sausage with the onion and pepper in oil.
Add the potatoes and paprika and crisp 8 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover until set.

name: Diner Home Fries with Eggs
steps: Dice the potatoes and onion.
Pan-fry in oil with paprika and salt until crisp, about 15 minutes.
Fry or scramble the eggs.
Serve together with parsley.

name: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Scramble the eggs with the spinach.
Fill half of each tortilla with eggs and cheddar and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil, 2 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa.

name: Ham and Cheese Western Omelet
steps: Dice the ham, pepper and onion and sauté in half the butter.
Cook the beaten eggs in the rest of the butter.
Add the filling and Swiss and fold.

name: Cheesy Potato and Egg Breakfast Skillet
steps: Crisp the bacon in a skillet and set aside.
Brown the diced potatoes in oil.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook gently.
Top with cheddar, bacon and green onion and cover to melt.

name: Peanut Butter and Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana and cinnamon.

name: Biscuit-Style Egg Muffin with Sausage
steps: Shape the sausage into four thin patties and brown.
Fry the eggs in butter.
Toast the bread.
Stack sausage, egg and cheddar between slices.

name: Hash Brown-Style Potato Cakes
steps: Grate the cooked potato and onion.
Mix with the egg and seasoning.
Shape into patties.
Pan-fry in oil until golden, 5 minutes a side.

name: Cinnamon Oatmeal with Peanut Butter
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter and cinnamon.
Top with diced apple.

name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts and Honey Drizzle
steps: Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with walnuts and a thin drizzle of honey.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Turkey Bacon, Egg and Tomato Breakfast Wrap
steps: Crisp the turkey bacon.
Scramble the eggs.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, bacon, tomato, spinach and cheddar.
Roll and halve.

name: Classic Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice.
Assemble with cheddar between, butter sides out.
Grill in a pan until golden, 3 to 4 minutes a side.

name: Turkey, Bacon and Avocado Club Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with mayo.
Layer turkey, bacon, avocado, tomato and romaine.
Cut into triangles.

name: BLT Sandwich with Avocado
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayo and mashed avocado.
Layer bacon, tomato and romaine.

name: Cheeseburger on a Bun
steps: Shape the beef into four patties and season with salt.
Grill or pan-sear 4 minutes a side; add cheddar for the last minute.
Toast the buns.
Build with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle and mustard.

name: Turkey Burger on a Whole Bun with Avocado
steps: Mix the turkey with paprika and salt and shape four patties.
Pan-sear 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Toast the buns.
Build with avocado, tomato, lettuce and onion.

name: Patty Melt
steps: Caramelise the onion slowly in oil.
Form two oval patties and sear.
Layer patty, onion and Swiss between buttered bread.
Grill until crisp and melted.

name: Hot Dog with Sauerkraut and Mustard
steps: Grill or pan-sear the sausages.
Warm the buns.
Fill with sausage, sauerkraut, mustard and onion.

name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, yogurt, mayo, mustard and lemon.
Pile onto bread with lettuce.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich on White
steps: Flake the tuna and mix with celery, chopped pickle and mayo.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich
steps: Slice the steak very thin.
Sauté the onion, pepper and mushrooms in oil.
Sear the steak, combine and top with Swiss to melt.
Pile into toasted buns.

name: Meatball Sub
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan, seasoning and garlic and shape twelve meatballs.
Brown, then simmer in the marinara for 15 minutes.
Fill the buns, top with mozzarella and broil briefly.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich with Slaw
steps: Use cooked, shredded pork shoulder.
Toss with the paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener and warm.
Mix the slaw with the yogurt.
Pile pork and slaw into the buns.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
steps: Sauté the pepper and onion in oil.
Fill half of each tortilla with chicken, vegetables and pepper jack and fold.
Crisp 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa.

name: Steak and Bean Burrito
steps: Season and sear the steak; slice.
Warm the beans and rice.
Fill each tortilla with steak, rice, beans, cheddar and salsa.
Roll tight and serve with avocado and lime.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Season the chicken and sear in oil, then slice.
Build bowls from rice, beans, corn and romaine.
Top with chicken, pico and avocado, with lime.

name: Turkey and Swiss on White with Mustard
steps: Spread the bread with mustard.
Layer turkey, Swiss, tomato and lettuce.

name: Ham and Cheddar Sandwich
steps: Spread the bread with mustard.
Layer ham, cheddar, tomato and lettuce.

name: Classic Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Cook the pasta al dente and drain.
Warm the milk with butter and mustard.
Melt in the cheddar until smooth.
Fold in the pasta and finish with paprika.

name: Baked Ziti with Turkey Sausage
steps: Cook the pasta slightly under al dente.
Brown the sausage with garlic and stir in the marinara.
Mix the pasta, sauce and ricotta in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic in oil.
Add the marinara and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and toss with the sauce.
Serve with parmesan.

name: Spaghetti and Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan, garlic and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Brown them, then simmer in the marinara for 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti.
Serve topped with meatballs, sauce and parsley.

name: Chicken Alfredo with Broccoli
steps: Sear the sliced chicken in butter and set aside.
Simmer the garlic and cream, then stir in the parmesan.
Cook the pasta with the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Toss everything together with pepper.

name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook the noodles al dente.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms in butter, add the milk and cheddar and stir until smooth.
Fold in the noodles, tuna and peas.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Beef Stroganoff over Egg Noodles
steps: Sear the sliced steak in oil and set aside.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms, add broth and mustard and reduce.
Stir in the sour cream and return the beef.
Serve over the noodles.

name: Chicken and Noodles
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Add the noodles to the broth and cook until tender.
Return the chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Chili Mac
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add chili powder, cumin, tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the cooked macaroni.
Top with cheddar.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Use cold, cooked rice.
Sear the diced chicken in oil, add garlic, carrot and peas.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then mix in the rice.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and finish with green onion.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Sear the shrimp in oil, 2 minutes, and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas, scramble in the eggs.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fold in the shrimp and green onion.

name: Jambalaya
steps: Brown the sausage and chicken in oil.
Add the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and cook until soft.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth and Cajun seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the rice and shrimp and cook until the rice is tender.

name: Red Beans and Rice
steps: Brown the sausage, then the onion, celery, pepper and garlic.
Add the beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans.
Serve over the rice.

name: Chicken and Rice Casserole
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in oil.
Mix the cooked rice, broccoli, onion, broth and garlic powder in a dish.
Top with the chicken and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Spanish Rice with Ground Turkey
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Stir in the spices and tomato sauce.
Fold in the cooked rice and simmer 8 minutes.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Mix the shredded chicken with onion and beans.
Dip the tortillas in warm enchilada sauce, fill and roll.
Pack seam-down in a dish, cover with sauce and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes and add cilantro.

name: Beef Tacos with Corn Tortillas
steps: Brown the beef with the taco seasoning.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheddar and salsa.
Top with sour cream.

name: Loaded Nachos with Beans and Chicken
steps: Spread the chips on a tray.
Top with chicken, beans and cheddar.
Bake at 400°F for 8 minutes until melted.
Finish with pico, guacamole, jalapeno and sour cream.

name: Shepherd's Pie with Mashed Potato Topping
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrot; stir in paste, broth, thyme and peas.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Spread the beef in a dish and cover with the mash.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Meatloaf Dinner with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Mix the beef, egg, oat bran, onion and salt; press into a loaf pan, spread with paste and bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Steam the beans.
Serve slices with the sides.

name: Fish and Chips (Oven-Baked)
steps: Bake the fries according to the package.
Dip the cod in egg, then almond flour mixed with Old Bay.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Stir the yogurt with chopped pickle and lemon for a tartar sauce.

name: Southern Salmon Croquettes with Lemon Dill Yogurt
steps: Mix the salmon, egg, crumbed bread, celery, onion and mustard.
Shape into patties and pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with lemon and dill and serve alongside.

name: Chicken Pot Pie Skillet
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and celery in butter.
Add the chicken, potatoes, broth and thyme and simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the milk and peas and thicken by simmering.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Roasted Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken and potatoes with oil, garlic, rosemary, paprika and salt.
Roast 40 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 15.

name: Sausage and Peppers over White Rice
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the pepper and onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the marinara and seasoning and simmer 8 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Beef and Broccoli over White Rice
steps: Sear the sliced steak in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger.
Return the steak with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve over the rice.

name: Teriyaki-Style Chicken Bowls
steps: Sear the chicken pieces in oil.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce and vinegar and cook until glazed.
Steam the broccoli and carrot.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

name: Southern Baked Chicken Legs with Rice
steps: Rub the chicken with oil and the spices.
Roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Sauté the collards briefly.
Serve with the rice.

name: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic with the bacon.
Add the potatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash partly, stir in the milk and half the cheddar.
Top with sour cream, green onion and the rest of the cheddar.

name: Corn Chowder
steps: Crisp the bacon, then soften the onion and celery.
Add the corn, potatoes, broth and thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend a third of the soup and stir back in with the milk.

name: Chicken and Rice Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot, celery, onion and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Add the cooked rice and heat through; finish with parsley.

name: Hearty Beef and Potato Stew
steps: Brown the cubed beef.
Add the onion, paste, broth, thyme and bay leaf and simmer 1 hour.
Add the potatoes, carrots and celery and cook 30 minutes more.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup with Egg Noodles
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Cook the noodles in the soup 6 minutes and return the chicken.

name: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese Dippers
steps: Simmer the tomatoes, broth, onion and garlic 15 minutes, blend and stir in the milk.
Make small grilled cheese sandwiches in butter and cut into strips.
Serve for dipping.

name: Vegetable Beef Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add everything else and simmer 35 minutes.

name: White Bean and Ham Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Simmer 35 minutes, mashing some beans for body.
Remove the bay leaf.

name: Mashed Potatoes with Garlic and Butter
steps: Boil the potatoes with the garlic until very tender.
Mash with warm milk, butter and salt.
Top with chives.

name: Twice Baked Potato with Cheddar and Chives
steps: Bake the potatoes, halve and scoop out the flesh.
Mash with yogurt, butter and half the cheddar.
Refill the skins, top with cheddar and bacon.
Bake 15 minutes more.

name: Baked Potato with Broccoli and Cheddar
steps: Bake the potatoes until tender, about 55 minutes.
Steam the broccoli.
Split the potatoes and fill with broccoli, cheddar and yogurt.

name: Oven-Roasted Potatoes with Rosemary
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potato chunks with oil, rosemary, garlic and seasoning.
Roast 30 to 35 minutes, turning once.

name: Classic Potato Salad
steps: Cube the cooked potatoes and slice the boiled eggs.
Mix the mayo, yogurt and mustard.
Fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery, onion and pickle.
Chill before serving.

name: Steakhouse Oven Fries
steps: Spread the fries on a tray.
Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes, turning once.
Season with salt and garlic powder.

name: Garlic Bread
steps: Mash the butter with garlic and parsley.
Spread on the bread and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake at 400°F for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: Rice Pilaf with Peas and Carrots
steps: Sauté the onion and carrot in butter.
Add the rice, peas and broth and heat through.
Finish with parsley.

name: Southern Baked Beans
steps: Crisp the bacon with the onion.
Stir in the paste, vinegar, mustard, sweetener, paprika and water.
Add the beans and bake covered at 325°F for 1 hour.

name: Green Bean Casserole (Lightened)
steps: Sauté the mushrooms, onion and garlic in butter.
Add the milk and parmesan and reduce until creamy.
Fold in the blanched green beans.
Top with chopped almonds and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Creamed Corn
steps: Warm the corn with butter and milk.
Stir in the cream cheese until smooth.
Season and top with chives.

name: Sweet Potato Casserole with Pecans
steps: Mash the cooked sweet potatoes with butter, milk, egg, cinnamon and vanilla.
Spread in a dish and top with chopped pecans.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Classic Coleslaw
steps: Whisk the yogurt, mayo, vinegar, mustard and sweetener.
Toss with the slaw mix and celery.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Spanish Rice
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil with the cumin.
Add the tomato sauce and broth and simmer 3 minutes.
Fold in the cooked rice.

name: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes (Lightened)
steps: Layer the sliced potatoes and onion in a dish.
Warm the milk with garlic, thyme and nutmeg and pour over.
Top with Swiss and bake covered at 375°F for 40 minutes, uncovered for 10.

name: Italian Sub Salad
steps: Chop the romaine, tomato and onion.
Add sliced meats, mozzarella and olives.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and seasoning and toss.

name: Chef Salad
steps: Arrange the romaine, cucumber and tomato.
Add rows of turkey, ham, sliced egg and Swiss.
Whisk the oil, mustard and vinegar and drizzle.

name: Greek-Style Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta and cool under water.
Toss with cucumber, tomatoes, onion and olives.
Dress with oil, vinegar and oregano and add feta.

name: Barbecue Chicken Salad
steps: Grill the chicken with a rub of paste, vinegar and paprika; slice.
Toss the romaine, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Top with chicken and avocado and drizzle with thinned yogurt.

name: Loaded Potato Skins with Bacon and Cheddar
steps: Bake the potatoes, halve and scoop out most of the flesh.
Brush the skins with oil and crisp for 10 minutes at 425°F.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and melt.
Top with yogurt and green onion.

name: Chips with Fresh Salsa and Guacamole
steps: Serve the chips with pico de gallo and guacamole.

name: Turkey and Cheese Roll-Ups
steps: Spread the turkey with mustard.
Add Swiss, pickle and lettuce.
Roll tight and slice.

name: Baked Pepper Jack Quesadilla Wedges
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with pepper jack and chiles.
Fold and crisp in a pan.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Bagel Chips with Hummus
steps: Slice the bagel thin, brush with oil and garlic powder.
Bake at 375°F for 10 to 12 minutes.
Serve with hummus and cucumber.

name: Cheese and Fruit Snack Plate
steps: Slice the cheeses and apple.
Arrange with the almonds and crackers.

name: Smothered Pork Chops with Rice
steps: Season the chops and sear in oil.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the pan, add broth and milk and simmer to a gravy.
Return the chops and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Oven BBQ Chicken Thighs with Slaw and Beans
steps: Whisk the paste, vinegar, paprika, garlic powder and sweetener into a sauce.
Coat the chicken and roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.
Toss the slaw with the yogurt.
Serve with warmed beans.

name: Slow Cooker Beef Chili with Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Put everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours.

name: Chili Cheese Baked Potato
steps: Bake the potatoes until tender.
Brown the beef with onion and chili powder; add tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Split the potatoes and top with chili and cheddar.

name: Turkey Chili Dogs
steps: Brown the ground turkey with the onion and chili powder; add the sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Grill the sausages.
Serve in buns with the chili and cheddar.

name: Cheese Pizza-Style Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas on a tray at 425°F for 3 minutes.
Spread with marinara, mozzarella and seasoning.
Bake 8 minutes and finish with basil.

name: Pepperoni-Style Turkey Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas.
Top with marinara, mozzarella, sliced sausage, pepper and onion.
Bake at 425°F for 8 minutes.

name: Apple Crisp with Oat Topping
steps: Slice the apples and toss with lemon, cinnamon and half the sugar.
Rub the oats, pecans, butter and remaining sugar into a crumble.
Spread over the apples and bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.

name: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: Simmer the cooked rice and milk for 15 minutes.
Whisk the egg with sugar and vanilla and stir in over low heat until thick.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Chocolate Pudding Cups
steps: Warm the milk with cocoa and sugar.
Whisk in the eggs over low heat until thick.
Add vanilla and chill.

name: Banana Oat Cookies
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with oats, walnuts, cinnamon and vanilla.
Scoop ten cookies onto a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

name: Strawberry Shortcake-Style Parfait
steps: Stir the vanilla and sweetener into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt, sliced strawberries and toasted oats in glasses.

name: Peanut Butter Hot Cocoa
steps: Warm the milk.
Whisk in cocoa, peanut butter, sweetener and vanilla until smooth.

name: Sugar-Free Lemonade
steps: Stir the juice and sweetener into the water until dissolved.
Serve over ice with mint.

name: Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice until smooth.

name: Blueberry Oat Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
